module.name: no-jest-have-been-called
module.description: Require exact call counts and invocation indices in Jest expect assertions, while allowing negated zero-call assertions.

scenarios.name: should allow toHaveBeenCalledTimes with an explicit count
should allow toHaveBeenNthCalledWith with an explicit index
should allow negated called matchers that assert zero calls
scenarios.when: the rule evaluates the assertion and its modifiers
scenarios.then: no violation is reported because the assertion requires zero calls

scenarios.name: should allow inherited object member names
scenarios.given: ordinary code accesses an Object.prototype member such as value.toString() or value.constructor
scenarios.then: no violation is reported because the name is not an own key of the banned matcher map

scenarios.name: should allow unrelated objects with matcher-shaped members
scenarios.given: an object other than a Jest expect result calls or references a member named toHaveBeenCalled

scenarios.name: should allow matcher property references without calls
scenarios.given: expect(fn).toHaveBeenCalled is read without invoking the matcher

scenarios.name: should allow unsupported intermediate members
scenarios.when: the rule traces the matcher receiver
scenarios.then: no violation is reported because custom is not a Jest assertion modifier

scenarios.name: should allow shadowed and unrelated expect bindings
scenarios.given: a local expect function or an expect import from another library has a banned matcher name
scenarios.when: the rule resolves the expect binding
scenarios.then: no Jest matcher violation is reported

scenarios.name: should allow a shadowed global object
scenarios.given: a local parameter named globalThis has an expect method with a banned matcher name
scenarios.when: the rule resolves the global object binding
scenarios.then: no Jest matcher violation is reported

scenarios.name: should report negated argument and promise matcher chains
scenarios.when: the rule traces the assertion modifiers

scenarios.name: should report global and imported Jest expect calls
scenarios.given: globalThis.expect(fn).toHaveBeenCalled(), globalThis['expect'](fn).toBeCalled(), or an alias imported from @jest/globals calls the matcher
scenarios.when: the rule resolves the expect call

scenarios.name: should report computed and optional matcher calls
scenarios.when: the rule evaluates the matcher call

scenarios.name: should allow optional and computed object prototype members
scenarios.given: toString, valueOf, hasOwnProperty, and __proto__ member access
scenarios.when: dot, bracket, and optional access are linted
scenarios.then: no Jest matcher diagnostic is emitted
